responsibility: Implements small utility visitors that support Rust type checking rather than performing full resolution themselves. In particular, it defines ImplTypeIterator, a focused visitor that walks impl items and invokes a callback for type aliases, used when associating impl-provided associated types back to their trait items.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation of the utility visitor declared in the header: it performs the actual impl-item walk and invokes the callback only for HIR::TypeAlias nodes, whereas the .h file only exposes the visitor interface.
